product-risk.detail: Scope and permissions approved in research.md; legal issuance/cancellation and retention are launch gates in operations.md, not invented guarantees.

runtime-deployment.detail: Vue 3, Symfony 7.4/PHP 8.4, PostgreSQL 18, Node 22; same-origin SPA/backend. Provider selection deferred separately.

responsibilities.detail: ARCH-01 defines layer dependencies; P1-P4 and P7 give dataflow, authorization, transaction boundaries and failures.

repository-structure.detail: rules.md and patterns.md prescribe future frontend/backend/contracts paths without application scaffolding.

language-conventions.detail: LANG-01 and tooling configurations select strict PHP/TypeScript, formatting and meaningful analysis; PHP execution unavailable.

api-contracts.detail: API-01-03: OpenAPI 3.1 authority, validated DTOs, generated types, problem responses, pagination and idempotency; product checks await actual operations.

data-persistence.detail: DATA-01-03 and P2/P3 define tenant isolation, NUMERIC(18,2)/64-bit checked money and quantity bounds, provisioned tenant counter locks/exhaustion, atomic issuance and migration review.

identity-security.detail: SEC-01-03 and P4/P7 define login/reset and account management, tenant authority guards, usable-owner preservation, optimistic versions and per-request session-version revocation.

frontend-interaction.detail: UI-01-02 and P1 define Vue composition, typed transport, errors, forms and keyboard/axe/manual accessibility.

background-concurrency.detail: JOB-01: PostgreSQL Messenger mail queue, at-least-once/retry/context cleanup; DATA-02 handles invoice/version concurrency.

local-development.detail: Node22 local and clean-copy checks verified. PHP/Composer/Docker absent; PHP lock resolution and PHP/container runtime checks unavailable. See verification.md.

verification-strategy.detail: TEST-01, patterns.md, check-product preflight and configured suite runners distinguish foundation tests from missing product tests.

performance-reliability.detail: API-03 bounded pages; JOB-01 bounded retries/timeouts; operations.md requires measured release budgets, alerts and restoration. No speculative SLA.

ci-review.detail: quality.yml and enforcement.md specify PR/main triggers, read-only pins, stable quality gate and administrator activation. Hosted behavior unverified.

build-supply-chain.detail: npm lock, compatible peer resolution, zero-advisory scan and pinned actionlint verified. PHP tool lock cannot resolve without PHP/Composer; local image tags are not production digests.

release-distribution.detail: operations.md defines immutable tested artifact identity, promotion, migration order, worker restart and rollback limits; no active deployment.

cd-infrastructure.detail: Production provider/identity/activation unchosen. No deployment workflow; operations.md specifies target-independent release contract.

operations-recovery.detail: Runbooks/log redaction/mail failure/restore criteria written; production host, retention, RPO/RTO and owner are launch prerequisites.

agent-guidance.detail: AGENTS.md routes five local skills and rules/patterns; direct-file fallback replaces unavailable native discovery in this trial.

maintenance-handoff.detail: operations.md/enforcement.md define ownership handoff, dependency review and explicit reassessment triggers; no caretaker installed.
